titre: Devoir de synthèse n°3 - Anglais (8ème année de base)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
Nadia is a fourteen-year-old girl who loves helping other people. She is a member of a youth club in her town. Every weekend, she and her friends visit an old people's home. They talk to the elderly, read them stories and help them with small tasks. "It makes me happy to see them smile," Nadia says. Last winter, the club organised a campaign to collect warm clothes and blankets for poor families. Thanks to their efforts, many families received help during the cold days. Nadia believes that even young people can change the world if they help each other.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (6 marks)
1) What does Nadia do every weekend?   (1,5 marks)
2) How does she feel when she helps the elderly?   (1,5 marks)
3) What did the club organise last winter?   (1,5 marks)
4) What does Nadia believe about young people?   (1,5 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Put the verb into the past simple: The club (organise) ______ a campaign.   (1,5 marks)
2) Complete with a relative pronoun (who / which): Nadia is a girl ______ loves helping others.   (1,5 marks)
3) Give the opposite of "poor" = ______.   (1,5 marks)
4) Complete with "can / can't": Young people ______ change the world.   (1,5 marks)

III. WRITING (8 marks)
"How can young people help their community?" Write a composition (about 10-12 lines) giving examples (helping the elderly, cleaning the environment, teaching others…) and explaining why it is important. Use "can / should" and linkers.
